context: Booking the flights and lodging online
purpose: Book the trip; teach ４月/空港/大体/スペイン/周辺/６月/英国/スーパー

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ４月の航空券、予約しちゃおうか。
lines.en: Shall we just book the April tickets?
lines.style: decisive friend ready to commit, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 空港は成田と羽田、どっちが安い？
lines.en: For the airport, is Narita or Haneda cheaper?
lines.style: cost-conscious friend comparing options, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大体同じだけど、羽田のほうが近いね。

lines.style: practical friend weighing convenience, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: スペインのホテル、周辺の治安も調べておこう。
lines.en: For the Spain hotel, let’s check the area’s safety too.
lines.style: careful friend doing due diligence, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ６月の英国は雨が多いって書いてある。
lines.en: It says the UK gets lots of rain in June.
lines.style: informed friend flagging the weather, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 折りたたみ傘、必須だね。
lines.en: A folding umbrella is a must, then.
lines.style: practical friend making a packing note

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現地のスーパーで食材を買えば節約できるよ。
lines.en: Buying groceries at the local supermarket would save money.
lines.style: budget-minded friend suggesting a tip, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね、旅費を大体の予算内に収めたい。
lines.en: Good, I want to keep costs roughly within budget.
lines.style: goal-oriented friend setting a target, tone holding steady through the whole line
